settings.business_description_hint: What you do, prices, address, hours. The bot uses this text to answer clients.
settings.jev_question_language_hint: The language of the built-in yes/no questions the bot asks itself about each message. Clients do not see them.
settings.languages_hint: The languages the bot replies in; scenarios are written in them too. The first one is the main one.
settings.reply_rules_hint: For example, ru → uk: a client who writes in Russian gets a reply in Ukrainian. * means any other language. Without a rule the bot replies in the client language if it is in the list, otherwise in the main one.
settings.silence_minutes_hint: If the client is silent this long in the middle of a scenario, the data collected so far is sent with status “incomplete”.
settings.sub: How the bot talks and what it knows about the business.

channels.merge_hint: Several messages in a row are answered once: the bot waits for a pause, but no longer than the maximum.
channels.no_scenarios: No scenarios in this channel. The bot only answers questions.
channels.operator_mode: Operator mode: the bot suggests replies, a human sends them
channels.order_hint: If two scenarios fit a message equally well, the one higher in the list goes first.
channels.overrides_hint: Empty means the tenant settings are used.
channels.sub: Where clients write to the bot, and which scenarios work there.
channels.title: Name

prompts.activate_confirm: Make version {v} active? The bot uses it from the next message.
prompts.activate_on_save: Make this version active right away
prompts.no_own_versions: This tenant has no own versions yet
prompts.override_hint: The tenant uses the shared prompt. Save a version here to give this tenant its own text.
prompts.placeholders_hint: Words in %PERCENT% are filled in by the bot; keep them as they are.
prompts.read_only: You can view prompts but not change them.
prompts.reset_confirm: Go back to the shared prompt? The own versions stay in history.
prompts.reset_done: The shared prompt is used again
prompts.sub_shared: Prompts for all tenants. A tenant can have its own version.
prompts.sub_tenant: The texts the bot is given for each step. Shared by default, can be changed for this tenant.

members.invite_hint: The person signs in with Google or an email link using this address. No invitation email is sent yet, so tell them yourself.
members.name: Name

role_hint.operator: Sees conversations and results, talks to clients.
role_hint.admin: Also sets up scenarios, prompts, channels and models.
role_hint.owner: Also manages the team, API keys and endpoints.

members.sub: Who has access to this tenant and what they can do.

api_keys.how_text: Send client messages with POST /v1/messages and the header Authorization: Bearer KEY. The reply comes in the response body.
api_keys.revoke_confirm: Revoke the key “{title}”? Requests with it stop working at once.
api_keys.sub: Keys for sending messages to the bot through the HTTP API.
api_keys.title: Name

endpoints.how_text: Each request carries X-Zama-Signature: sha256=HMAC_SHA256(secret, body) and Idempotency-Key. Check the signature with the secret and ignore a repeated Idempotency-Key.
endpoints.name: Name
endpoints.name_hint: Used in scenarios. Latin letters, digits and underscores; cannot be changed later.
endpoints.remove_confirm: Delete the endpoint “{name}”? Scenarios that send to it will stop sending.
endpoints.secret_hint: At least 16 characters. Your system uses it to check that the request came from us.
endpoints.sub: Where the bot sends collected data (your CRM or another system).
